stories.title: The motor home to the 1986 World Championships in Breckenridge
stories.excerpt: The Achenbachs at some point said they were going down to the world championships in Colorado, and Mom and Dad loaded up the motor home and we drove down to the World Championships of snowboarding in Breckenridge Colorado in 86. Four months after the first snowboard entered the family. That's when I started riding, when I saw what could be done.

stories.title: Winning the 1990 obstacle course for a Fishlip board
stories.excerpt: I think 90 when I won the West Beach Classic, which was just like an obstacle course race. I won a fish lip snowboard for first place.
